purpose: Compare a provider predictor with a diagnostic SEC-tag calculation; not a stock signal or return
omitted_accrued_expense_change: Unknown; zero used only for diagnostic arithmetic, not as a verified missing Compustat value

prior_period_comparative_check.scope: Selected period-end tags in these two filings only; no intervening filing or Compustat comparison.

limitations: The SEC tags are candidate mappings; their equivalence to Compustat fields is unverified.
The provider's calculation inputs, fiscal period, identity mapping and point-in-time vintage are unverified.
The arithmetic residual is not proof of a particular accrued-liability amount or cause; multiple mismatched components can offset.
The later 2022 annual filing supplies comparative figures and cannot establish complete revision history or public availability timing.
No security ranking or return is calculated.
